description.value:
A bitter grey liquid that steams only when nobody is watching. Drinking the draught forces the body through the useful part of rest without granting it the time in which rest normally occurs.

Rules

As an action, drink the draught. You immediately gain the benefits of a short rest and may spend Hit Dice. Features that recharge on a short rest recharge. You then gain one level of exhaustion that cannot be removed until you finish a long rest lasting at least 12 hours. A second draught within 24 hours grants only the exhaustion.

Vault Record

Classification: Sanctioned. Rules: D&D 5e (2014). Custody: Wayreth Deep Catalogue.

description.chatFlavor: Gain the benefits of a short rest immediately, then gain one level of exhaustion. The exhaustion remains until a 12-hour long rest is completed.

description.value:
A red suspension that separates into three perfectly level bands whenever the bottle is still. It was devised by Red Robes who considered duration another material that a spellcaster should be able to negotiate.

Rules

As a bonus action, drink the potion and choose one spell of 3rd level or lower currently affecting you or a creature you can see within 30 feet. Either double that spell's remaining duration or end it immediately. This cannot increase a spell beyond twice its original duration and does not transfer concentration.

Vault Record

Classification: Sanctioned. Rules: D&D 5e (2014). Custody: Wayreth Deep Catalogue.

description.chatFlavor: Choose a spell of 3rd level or lower affecting the target. Double its remaining duration, to a maximum of twice its original duration, or end it.

description.value:
A stoppered vial contains ash recovered from a destroyed Tower of High Sorcery. The powder remembers the instant when a place built to contain magic ceased to do so.

Rules

As an action, scatter the ash across a 10-foot square within reach. For 1 minute, spells of 5th level or lower cannot be cast from within the area, and ongoing spells and magical effects of 5th level or lower are suppressed there. Time spent suppressed counts against duration. The ash affects allies, enemies, and its user equally.

Vault Record

Classification: Sanctioned. Rules: D&D 5e (2014). Custody: Wayreth Deep Catalogue.

description.chatFlavor: Creates a 10-foot-square dead zone for 1 minute. Spells and magical effects of 5th level or lower are prevented or suppressed within it.

description.value:
This clear, tasteless restorative was designed for healers who needed a patient alive now and were willing to make tomorrow's recovery the patient's problem.

Rules

As an action, drink the potion to regain 8d4 + 8 hit points and end one disease or one of these conditions: blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned. The next long rest you complete restores no hit points, Hit Dice, spell slots, or expended class features. A second dose does not postpone or multiply that debt.

Vault Record

Classification: Restricted. Rules: D&D 5e (2014). Custody: Wayreth Deep Catalogue.

description.chatFlavor: Regain 8d4 + 8 hit points and end one listed disease or condition. Your next long rest restores no resources.

effects.name: Rest Owed
effects.description: The creature's next long rest restores no hit points, Hit Dice, spell slots, or class features. Remove this effect after that rest.

description.value:
A single burned-edged leaf in an unidentified hand. The page contains one fixed spell of 8th or 9th level selected by the GM when it is first examined. The writing subtly rearranges itself around the reader's attention.

Rules

As an action, attempt to cast the page's spell by making a DC 19 Intelligence (Arcana) check. On a success, the spell takes effect normally and the page is consumed. On a failure, the spell still takes effect, but the GM controls its targets and choices; the page is not consumed and its charge is restored.

Vault Record

Classification: Restricted. Rules: D&D 5e (2014). Custody: Wayreth Deep Catalogue.

description.chatFlavor: Make a DC 19 Intelligence (Arcana) check. Success casts the fixed spell and consumes the page. Failure casts it under the page's control and the GM restores the page's use.

description.value:
Forty loose pages of annotations attributed to Magius. When bound into a spellbook, the notes respond to the book's contents with terse alternatives and impatient corrections.

Rules

Once per long rest when you cast a spell from the spellbook containing these pages, choose one benefit: cast it as though using a slot one level higher without expending the higher slot; change all its damage to force; or increase its range by 30 feet. This cannot raise a spell above 9th level.

Vault Record

Classification: Sanctioned. Rules: D&D 5e (2014). Custody: Wayreth Deep Catalogue.

description.chatFlavor: Cast a spell from the bound spellbook as though using a slot one level higher.
Change all damage dealt by the spell to force damage.
Increase the spell's range by 30 feet.

description.value:
A black ledger that writes in three colors without ink. It records every spell of 3rd level or higher cast within 20 miles, noting the spell, approximate location, and the name of any caster recognized by the Orders.

Rules

Consulting one hour of entries takes 1 minute. The record cannot identify a disguised or unknown caster, but repeated signatures can be compared with a DC 15 Intelligence (Arcana) check. The ledger cannot be written in, erased, or moved across a planar boundary while open.

Vault Record

Classification: Restricted. Rules: D&D 5e (2014). Custody: Wayreth Deep Catalogue.

description.chatFlavor: Review one hour of spellcasting recorded within 20 miles. Arcana can compare unknown magical signatures.

description.value:
A sheet of Istaran vellum scraped so many times that it is nearly translucent. Against a document, its buried fibers remember what authority tried to remove.

Rules

Hold the palimpsest against a written document for 1 minute. It reveals prior text that was altered, censored, scraped away, or overwritten, provided the document is no more than 1,000 years old and the alteration is at least 30 days old. It does not translate the revealed language or expose text that was never physically present.

Vault Record

Classification: Sanctioned. Rules: D&D 5e (2014). Custody: Wayreth Deep Catalogue.

description.chatFlavor: Reveal earlier physical text removed from a document up to 1,000 years old, if the alteration is at least 30 days old.

description.value:
An unmarked band of black iron. Its surface becomes cold eight days before it is ready to preserve its wearer again.

Rules

When you would drop to 0 hit points, you can use your reaction to drop to 1 hit point instead and become invisible until the end of your next turn. The ring then cannot be used for 8 days. Its charge is intentionally not recovered automatically; reduce Spent Uses to 0 after eight in-world days.

Vault Record

Classification: Restricted. Rules: D&D 5e (2014). Custody: Wayreth Deep Catalogue.

description.chatFlavor: Drop to 1 hit point instead of 0 and become invisible until the end of your next turn. Manually restore the ring after eight days.

effects.name: Ninth-Day Invisibility
effects.description: The wearer is invisible until the end of their next turn.

description.value:
Silver, red enamel, and black inlay meet without one color crossing another. The ring was made for envoys expected to negotiate while the heavens favored one side.

Rules

While attuned and worn, you ignore the penalties of low sanction and gain none of the benefits of high sanction. The ring affects only the moon of your own Order. The Wayreth calendar remains the authority for the current phase.

Vault Record

Classification: Sanctioned. Rules: D&D 5e (2014). Custody: Wayreth Deep Catalogue.

description.chatFlavor: This attuned wearer ignores low-sanction penalties and receives no high-sanction benefits.

effects.name: Balanced Sanction
effects.description: Ignore low-sanction penalties and gain no high-sanction benefits while this item is attuned and equipped.

description.value:
A short white baton carved with the first words of the Tower's rule on undeclared magic. It protects a spell by making secrecy impossible.

Rules

As a bonus action, audibly name one spell you have prepared. Until the end of your next turn, your casting of that spell is declared for the Tower's rules and cannot be counterspelled by a creature that heard the declaration. The protection ends after that casting or when the duration expires.

Vault Record

Classification: Sanctioned. Rules: D&D 5e (2014). Custody: Wayreth Deep Catalogue.

description.chatFlavor: Name one prepared spell. Until the end of your next turn, listeners cannot counterspell your declared casting of it.

description.value:
A dark metal rod bearing a replaceable brass plate for the current writ. The Orders reclaim each rod from its hunter's estate and record every bearer.

Rules

As an action, point at a creature within 60 feet and speak the writ. It must make a DC 16 Charisma saving throw. On a failure, for 1 minute it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw before casting any spell; on a failure the spell fails and its slot is expended. The creature repeats the Charisma save at the end of each turn, ending the effect on a success.

Vault Record

Classification: Restricted. Rules: D&D 5e (2014). Custody: Wayreth Deep Catalogue.

description.chatFlavor: On a failed Charisma save, the target must pass a DC 16 Constitution save before each spell for 1 minute. Repeat the Charisma save at end of turn.

effects.name: Hunter's Writ
effects.description: Before casting a spell, make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the spell fails and its slot is expended. Repeat the Charisma save at the end of each turn.

description.value:
A pale wand whose silver flame produces no heat. The light does not dispel magical darkness; it persists inside it, a cold point by which distance can still be judged.

Rules

The wand has 7 charges and regains 1d6 + 1 at dawn. As an action, expend 1 charge to shed bright light for 30 feet and dim light for 30 more until dismissed. Alternatively expend 3 charges to outline invisible creatures within 30 feet for 1 minute. Outlined creatures remain invisible but cast clearly visible shadows and cannot benefit from being hidden solely by invisibility.

Vault Record

Classification: Sanctioned. Rules: D&D 5e (2014). Custody: Wayreth Deep Catalogue.

description.chatFlavor: Shed 30 feet of bright light and 30 feet of dim light until dismissed.
Invisible creatures in 30 feet remain invisible but cast visible shadows for 1 minute.

effects.name: Outlined by Cold Light
effects.description: The creature remains invisible but casts a clearly visible shadow and cannot hide solely because of invisibility.

description.value:
The wand is made from four mismatched lengths of black wood joined without seams. Magic items near it feel briefly ordinary to an attuned bearer.

Rules

As an action, expend 1 charge and target a non-artifact magic item within 30 feet. If carried, its bearer makes a DC 17 Charisma saving throw. On a failure the item is suppressed for 1 minute. Expend all 4 charges instead to attempt permanent unmaking; on a failed save the target item and this wand are destroyed. The wand regains 1d4 charges at dawn.

Vault Record

Classification: Restricted. Rules: D&D 5e (2014). Custody: Wayreth Deep Catalogue.

description.chatFlavor: On a failed bearer Charisma save, suppress a non-artifact magic item for 1 minute.
On a failed bearer Charisma save, destroy the non-artifact item and this wand. The GM deletes both items.

description.value:
A dark mahogany quarterstaff crowned by a golden dragon claw clutching a pale crystal. The staff predates the wizard Magius whose name it bears, but it became inseparable from the legend of Raistlin Majere. The command Shirak kindles the crystal; Dulak extinguishes it.

Artifact Properties

Magic Weapon and Focus. The Staff of Magius is a +2 quarterstaff and an arcane spellcasting focus. While holding it, you gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class and saving throws.

Returning Staff. While attuned to the staff and on the same plane of existence, you can use a bonus action to call it to your empty hand. Ordinary fire cannot damage the staff.

Charges. The staff has 10 charges and regains 1d6 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. While holding it, you can expend charges to use the activities below. Light costs no charges.

Magius's Shaping. When you cast a spell that chiefly manipulates light, air, or a creature's mind, you can expend 1 charge to apply one shaping: Extended doubles its duration to a maximum of 24 hours; Empowered lets you reroll a number of the spell's damage dice up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum one), using the new rolls; or Enlarged doubles a ranged spell's range, or increases one cone, line, cube, sphere, or cylinder dimension by 50 percent, rounded up to the nearest 5 feet. A spell can benefit from only one shaping.

Raistlin's Awakening

Raistlin unlocked powers the staff does not reveal to ordinary wielders. When the staff is attuned to Raistlin Majere — or, at the GM's discretion, to a 17th-level or higher Wizard of High Sorcery whom the staff accepts — the wielder also gains a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls and advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. A hit with the staff deals an extra 1d6 force damage. The awakened staff can also hold up to 5 levels of spells, functioning as a ring of spell storing; only the attuned wielder can release those stored spells.

Unwilling Hands

A creature that is not an arcane spellcaster cannot attune to the staff. If such a creature willingly grips it, the creature must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or take 4d6 psychic damage, drop the staff, and be frightened of it until the end of its next turn. On a success, the creature takes half as much damage and drops it.

Vault Record

Classification: Unique artifact; personal custody of Raistlin Majere. Rules: D&D 5e. Custody: Not a Wayreth holding. Any catalogue entry describing it as such is a clerical fiction.

description.chatFlavor: A +2 quarterstaff strike. Use Awakened Strike instead when the staff has revealed Raistlin's greater power.
Raistlin's awakened Staff of Magius adds 1d6 force damage to the normal +2 quarterstaff strike.

activation.condition: The spell must originate from the crystal at the head of the staff.

description.chatFlavor: The crystal shines until you speak Dulak or the spell ends.
The staff arrests your fall with impossible gentleness.

activation.condition: The light must originate from the staff.

description.chatFlavor: The staff crystal blazes like a small moon.

activation.condition: Target a lock, bar, or sealed closure.

description.chatFlavor: The crystal flares blue-white and the obstruction softens or springs free.
The staff was recorded parting water for its bearer.
The awakened routes hidden in the staff carry the bearer and companions away.
Apply Extended, Empowered, or Enlarged to one qualifying light, air, or mind spell.
If the staff is on the same plane and you are attuned to it, it flies or vanishes into your empty hand.

effects.name: Staff of Magius — Warding
effects.description: While held: +2 AC and +2 to saving throws. Raistlin's Awakening also grants +2 to spell attack rolls and advantage on saves against spells and magical effects. Kept as descriptive automation-neutral text for compatibility across supported dnd5e versions.

description.value:
Cut from a roof beam carried out of Daltigoth before the Tower's destruction. The staff remembers being architecture and resists magic cast by anyone sharing its shelter.

Rules

While holding the staff, you have advantage on saving throws against spells cast by creatures inside the same structure. The staff has 10 charges, regains 1d6 + 4 at dawn, and offers Counterspell (3 charges), Dispel Magic (3), Mordenkainen's Private Sanctum (4), and Wall of Force (5). Cast activities resolve against the installed dnd5e spell compendium during installation.

Vault Record

Classification: Restricted. Rules: D&D 5e (2014). Custody: Wayreth Deep Catalogue.

effects.name: Memory of Shelter
effects.description: Advantage on saving throws against spells cast by creatures inside the same structure.

description.value:
Plain grey wood, warm to the touch, with no visible rune or join. It does not increase power. It removes uncertainty and collects payment afterward.

Rules

Once per long rest, before casting a spell, declare that it will succeed. The spell requires no attack roll, allows no saving throw, cannot be counterspelled, and ignores resistance and immunity. The GM adjudicates effects that cannot logically apply. Afterward roll 1d20. On 10 or lower, gain a permanent Mark from the Test of High Sorcery journal.

Vault Record

Classification: Restricted. Rules: D&D 5e (2014). Custody: Wayreth Deep Catalogue.

description.chatFlavor: The next declared spell succeeds without attack, save, counterspell, resistance, or immunity. On a d20 result of 10 or lower, apply a permanent Mark.

description.value:
A small hourglass of black glass. Its sand does not fall until the bearer draws on the patient presence sealed inside it.

Rules

While attuned, you do not age and have advantage on death saving throws. Once per long rest when a creature within 60 feet drops to 0 hit points, you can use your reaction to regain hit points equal to half its hit point maximum. Once per long rest you can take one additional action on your turn. After seven total uses of either activated property, attunement cannot end except by wish or divine intervention.

Vault Record

Classification: Interdicted. Rules: D&D 5e (2014). Custody: Wayreth Deep Catalogue.

description.chatFlavor: When a creature within 60 feet drops to 0 hit points, regain hit points equal to half its hit point maximum. Record one sand use.
Take one additional action this turn. Record one sand use. After seven total sand uses, attunement becomes permanent.

effects.name: Unfallen Sand
effects.description: The attuned bearer does not age and has advantage on death saving throws. Track the artifact's seven-use cost manually.

description.value:
A smoke-grey lens in a scorched silver frame. When held to one eye, soot drifts backward through the glass and reconstructs an echo of recent spellcraft.

Rules

As an action, examine a room or 30-foot area you occupy. The lens shows a silent image of the last spell cast there, including its caster and visible targets, but not spoken words or hidden creatures. It also shows one spell the viewer sincerely regrets not casting, chosen by the GM. The lens works once per dawn.

Vault Record

Classification: Sanctioned. Rules: D&D 5e (2014). Custody: Wayreth Deep Catalogue.

description.chatFlavor: See a silent image of the last spell cast in this 30-foot area and one spell the viewer regrets not casting.

description.value:
A thumb-sized bronze bell without a clapper. It rings inside the holder's teeth when nearby architecture lies about where it leads.

Rules

While carried, the bell silently alerts you whenever a portal within 300 feet leads somewhere other than its frame, map, or apparent space suggests. As an action, you can sound it audibly; until the end of your next turn, every false, extradimensional, or concealed door within 300 feet opens if it is capable of opening. This does not unlock mundane locks.

Vault Record

Classification: Sanctioned. Rules: D&D 5e (2014). Custody: Wayreth Deep Catalogue.

description.chatFlavor: Every false, extradimensional, or concealed door within 300 feet opens until the end of your next turn if capable of opening.

description.value:
A spool holding exactly enough black thread to repair one ruined magical text. The thread passes through parchment without making holes.

Rules

Over 10 minutes, stitch together a torn or damaged spell scroll. The restored scroll can be cast once without an ability check even if its spell is above the caster's normal level. When the spell is cast, the user permanently forgets one mundane autobiographical memory selected by the GM. The thread is consumed during repair.

Vault Record

Classification: Sanctioned. Rules: D&D 5e (2014). Custody: Wayreth Deep Catalogue.

description.chatFlavor: Repair one damaged spell scroll. It can be cast once without an ability check; its user permanently loses one mundane memory.

description.value:
A clear crystal cup whose reflections lag one heartbeat behind. The second image holds what the first has rejected.

Rules

As an action, pour a drink into the chalice and choose one poison, disease, or magical corruption present in the liquid or in a creature that drinks it. The chosen impurity is removed. Until sunrise it remains alive as a visible stain moving inside the cup. If the chalice breaks before sunrise, the impurity escapes and affects the nearest valid creature.

Vault Record

Classification: Restricted. Rules: D&D 5e (2014). Custody: Wayreth Deep Catalogue.

description.chatFlavor: Remove one poison, disease, or magical corruption. It remains contained in the chalice until sunrise.

description.value:
The ivory needle points toward deliberate omissions rather than north. Its case has no hinge on the side nearest home.

Rules

As an action, name a place, structure, or route you believe was deliberately removed from maps. For 1 hour, the compass points toward the nearest surviving entrance to such a route within 10 miles. If none exists, it spins. It cannot point toward a place the attuned bearer considers home, and attempts to redefine home fail until attunement ends.

Vault Record

Classification: Sanctioned. Rules: D&D 5e (2014). Custody: Wayreth Deep Catalogue.

description.chatFlavor: For 1 hour, point toward the nearest surviving entrance to a deliberately erased route within 10 miles. The compass never points home.

description.value:
A brass bookmark darkened at the edges. It is warmest beside information someone expects to lose.

Rules

When a book, scroll, or set of papers within reach would be destroyed by fire, acid, rot, or magical decay, use your reaction to preserve one chosen page perfectly. Another page in the same work, selected randomly by the GM, becomes permanently blank. The index is consumed.

Vault Record

Classification: Sanctioned. Rules: D&D 5e (2014). Custody: Wayreth Deep Catalogue.

description.chatFlavor: Preserve one page from destruction. Another page in the same work becomes permanently blank.

description.value:
A narrow candle marked with sixty divisions. Its flame burns downward only while a ritual is being performed nearby.

Rules

Light the candle as an action during a ritual with a casting time of at least 10 minutes. The ritual gains one additional hour before interruption, instability, or a deadline causes it to fail. Every participating creature ages one day and later dreams the borrowed hour from the perspective of the candle. The candle is consumed.

Vault Record

Classification: Sanctioned. Rules: D&D 5e (2014). Custody: Wayreth Deep Catalogue.

description.chatFlavor: Extend the safe casting window of one nearby ritual by 1 hour. Every participant ages one day.

description.value:
A long silver needle with no eye. It becomes warm near a mind occupied by a will that is not its own.

Rules

As an action, touch a creature to end one charm or possession affecting it. No check is required, but effects created by artifacts or deities are merely suppressed until the end of the creature's next turn. The wielder immediately experiences the expelled influence's strongest current desire and must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom save or be frightened of its source for 1 minute.

Vault Record

Classification: Sanctioned. Rules: D&D 5e (2014). Custody: Wayreth Deep Catalogue.

description.chatFlavor: End one charm or possession. The wielder makes DC 15 Wisdom save or is frightened of the influence's source for 1 minute.

description.value:
A bottle of black ink visible only as a slight absence of reflected light. One bottle contains enough ink for ten pages.

Rules

Spend 10 minutes and 1 use to write one page, naming a reader. The writing is visible only to that reader, to creatures capable of seeing Nuitari, and under the full black moon. If the named reader dies, the text chooses the next creature to read it and reveals itself when that creature first touches the page.

Vault Record

Classification: Sanctioned. Rules: D&D 5e (2014). Custody: Wayreth Deep Catalogue.

description.chatFlavor: Write one page visible only to the named reader, Nuitari's servants, or under the full black moon.

description.value:
A folding brass scale with one red pan and one empty hook. It weighs components against consequences.

Rules

Spend 1 minute concentrating on a spell or ritual you know. The measure states the exact mundane material components and monetary value needed to cast it under present conditions. If the working also requires a sacrifice, broken oath, permanent transformation, or other human cost, the empty hook writes that cost in red light. The measure does not judge whether the price is acceptable.

Vault Record

Classification: Sanctioned. Rules: D&D 5e (2014). Custody: Wayreth Deep Catalogue.

description.chatFlavor: Learn the exact material and monetary cost of a known working, plus any human or permanent cost it requires.

description.value:
A palm-sized black stone cut from an unused foundation key. Its faces show angles that belong to structures not yet built.

Rules

As an action, hold the stone against a structure. For 1 minute you see structural stress, active wards, extradimensional spaces, concealed rooms, and load-bearing points within 120 feet. The structure becomes aware of you in whatever manner its magic or genius permits. Sentient structures know your name; ordinary buildings announce you through settling, bells, or opening doors.

Vault Record

Classification: Restricted. Rules: D&D 5e (2014). Custody: Wayreth Deep Catalogue.

description.chatFlavor: See structural stress, wards, concealed spaces, and load-bearing points within 120 feet. The structure becomes aware of you.

description.value:
A living white thorn wrapped in silver thread. It roots in stone, wood, or earth and flowers only while something outside wants to enter.

Rules

As an action, plant the thorn in a surface. For 1 hour, summoned creatures cannot enter a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on it unless they succeed on a DC 17 Charisma saving throw. A creature already inside makes the save immediately and is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space outside on a failure. No creature inside the sanctuary can knowingly speak a lie.

Vault Record

Classification: Sanctioned. Rules: D&D 5e (2014). Custody: Wayreth Deep Catalogue.

description.chatFlavor: Create a 20-foot-radius sanctuary for 1 hour. Summoned creatures must pass DC 17 Charisma to enter; creatures inside cannot knowingly lie.
